tools.name: canvas_pin_nodes
tools.description: Pin nodes to include them in the agent context. Pinned nodes appear in the canvas://pinned-context resource. The human can also pin nodes by clicking in the browser.

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to pin

mode.description: set: replace all pins, add: add to existing pins, remove: unpin these nodes (default: set)

reason.description: Why these nodes matter; kept with newly pinned nodes and shown to the human on hover.

tools.name: canvas_invoke_command
tools.description: Invoke a registry-gated PMX command intent (pmx.plan | pmx.execute | pmx.promote-context | pmx.summarize | pmx.review). Records a timeline event a host/agent can observe — NOT arbitrary execution; unknown names are rejected.

name.description: A command name from the PMX command registry.

source.description: Optional host/source label. Defaults to mcp.

tools.name: canvas_batch
tools.description: Run a non-atomic batch of canvas operations with optional assigned references. Use assign to name a result, then reference it later as "$name" for the created node id or "$name.id" for a specific result field. On failure, earlier successful operations remain applied and the response includes ok:false, failedIndex, error, results, and refs. Supports node.add, node.update, node.remove, graph.add, edge.add, edge.remove, group.create, group.add, group.remove, pin.set/add/remove, snapshot.save, and arrange.

assign.description: Optional reference name for later operations

full.description: Return full batch operation results. Default false compacts node-like payloads.

tools.name: canvas_import
tools.description: Agent-assisted document ingestion. List jobs, read attachment metadata/download bytes, submit bounded Markdown extraction, or report unavailable. Request, commit, and cancel are human-only HTTP actions.

action.description: Operation to perform: list | read | submit | unavailable.

tools.name: canvas_snapshot
tools.description: Canvas snapshots: save the current state, list saved snapshots, restore one, delete one, garbage-collect old ones, or diff the live canvas against one. Action "save" stores a named snapshot; "list" returns saved snapshots (newest first); "restore" replaces the live canvas with a snapshot; "delete" removes one; "gc" keeps the newest N and deletes the rest (dryRun to preview); "diff" shows added/removed/modified nodes and edges versus a snapshot (by name or id).

action.description: Operation to perform: save | list | restore | delete | gc | diff.

name.description: Name for this snapshot (e.g., "before refactor", "investigation v2")

q.description: Query alias used by the HTTP/CLI surface

before.description: Only return snapshots created at or before this ISO timestamp

after.description: Only return snapshots created at or after this ISO timestamp

all.description: Return all snapshots instead of the default limit

id.description: Snapshot ID or name to restore (from canvas_snapshot or snapshot list)

keep.description: Number of newest snapshots to keep (default: 20)

dryRun.description: Preview deletions without removing snapshot files

snapshot.description: Snapshot name or ID to compare against

tools.name: canvas_board
tools.description: Boards in this workspace — the library of the human's and your working memory, filed in categories on Home. Your writes always go to the open board (activeBoardId); on Home (no board open) your first write opens the most recent board, or a new one when there are none. Action "list" returns every board (with its category), most recently opened first; "get" reads one (default: the open board); "create" makes a new empty board WITHOUT opening it (optional category); "open" explicitly switches the shared workbench to id (null or omitted opens Home), changing the visible board and subsequent write target. After creating a board, open its returned id and verify activeBoardId before writing; another participant can switch the board later. "update" renames a board, files it under a category (category "" removes it), or designates its README via readmeNodeId. As part of normal board authoring, read the board metadata; if readmeNodeId is null, choose or create a concise markdown introduction explaining its purpose and key context, then designate that node with "update". Preserve an existing README unless the human asks to change it; humans can override the designation manually. "pin" adds a board to the working set (its README and pinned cards reach your brief whichever board is open; optional reason), "unpin" removes it; a pinned board is read-only context, never a write target. Only the human deletes boards.

action.description: Operation to perform: list | get | create | create-from | open | update | pin | unpin.

category.description: Folder path on Home, e.g. Engineering/Canvas

preview.description: Return reusable cards and structure without creating

readmeNodeId.description: Markdown node id used as the board README

reason.description: Why this board matters; shown to the human on hover

tools.name: canvas_node
tools.description: Create, read, update, or remove a canvas node. One tool for node CRUD: action "add" creates a node (requires type — markdown, status, context, ledger, trace, file, image, webpage, html, group, etc.); "get" reads one node by id; "update" patches an existing node (title, content, position, size, data); "remove" deletes a node by id. For spec-driven content (json-render, graph) use canvas_render; for external/built apps use canvas_app (actions: open-mcp-app, diagram, build-artifact).

action.description: Operation to perform: add | get | update | remove.

intentId.description: Ghost intent id returned by canvas_intent signal. A vetoed or expired intent blocks this mutation.

content.description: Node content (markdown for markdown nodes, file path for file nodes, image path/URL/data-URI for image nodes, URL for webpage nodes)

path.description: Compatibility alias for image node content. Prefer content for image paths.

url.description: Canonical webpage URL field for webpage nodes. Overrides content when both are provided.

strictSize.description: Keep explicit width/height fixed and scroll overflowing content instead of browser auto-fitting

children.description: Group-only alias for childIds. Node IDs to include in a generic group node.

childIds.description: Group-only field. Node IDs to include in a generic group node. Prefer canvas_group {action:"create"} for groups.

childLayout.description: Group-only optional layout for grouped children.

toolName.description: Trace node tool or operation label

category.description: Trace node category: mcp, file, subagent, or other

status.description: Trace node status: running, success, or failed

data.description: Extra node data merged into the created node.

description.description: Short description included in search and pinned/spatial context (html nodes).

presentation.description: Marks an html node as a fullscreen presentation/deck.

slideTitles.description: Agent-readable slide titles for presentation HTML.

embeddedNodeIds.description: Canvas node IDs embedded or represented by this HTML surface.

embeddedUrls.description: URLs embedded or represented by this HTML surface.

axCapabilities.description: Opt an html node into AX interactions. Merged into node data for html nodes; clamped to the node-type ceiling server-side.

position.description: Geometry alias: { x, y } object form.

size.description: Geometry alias: { width, height } object form.

full.description: Return the full created node payload. Default false returns compact metadata.

board.description: Board id to read without opening it.

includeBlobs.description: Include full blob payloads instead of blob summaries.

expectedContentRevision.description: Reject an edit based on stale content

spec.description: New json-render spec, or a graph payload with graphType/data for graph nodes

graphType.description: Graph type when updating a graph node

chartHeight.description: Graph chart content height, distinct from node height

pinned.description: Pin or unpin the node to exclude it from auto-arrange

arrangeLocked.description: Prevent auto-arrange from moving this node. Pinned nodes are also skipped.

refresh.description: Webpage nodes: pass true to re-fetch the page instead of patching fields.

tools.name: canvas_render
tools.description: Spec-driven content: discover the schema, validate a payload, or create a json-render / graph node. Action "describe-schema" returns the json-render component catalog + create schemas; "validate" checks a spec or graph payload without creating a node; "add-json-render" creates a json-render node from a complete spec; "stream-json-render" progressively builds one from SpecStream patches (omit nodeId to create, pass it back to append, done=true to finish); "add-graph" creates a chart node (line, bar, pie, area, scatter, radar, stacked-bar, composed, sparkline, dot-plot, bullet, slopegraph); "workboard" materializes a live AX work-item board (a json-render node with a column per status) that auto-refreshes whenever work items change — idempotent, rebuilding the existing board in place.

action.description: Operation to perform: describe-schema | validate | add-json-render | stream-json-render | add-graph | workboard.

spec.description: json-render spec to validate when type="json-render"

primitiveData.description: HTML primitive data payload when type="html-primitive"

zKey.description: Optional bubble-size key for scatter charts

nameKey.description: Slice name key for pie graphs

valueKey.description: Value key for pie slices, sparkline, dot-plot, and the bullet measure

metrics.description: Series keys to plot as radar polygons

barKey.description: Bar series key for composed charts

lineKey.description: Line series key for composed charts

colorBy.description: Bar charts only: how bars are colored (default 'series')

highlight.description: Bar charts only, colorBy='series': which bar gets the accent

barColor.description: Optional bar color for composed charts

lineColor.description: Optional line color for composed charts

labelKey.description: Category label key for dot-plot / bullet / slopegraph rows

targetKey.description: Per-row target value key for bullet charts

rangesKey.description: Per-row qualitative band thresholds key (number[]) for bullet charts

beforeLabel.description: Header label for the slopegraph left column

afterLabel.description: Header label for the slopegraph right column

sort.description: Row sort order for dot-plot (defaults to desc)

fill.description: Sparkline: draw a light area fill under the line

showEndDot.description: Sparkline: draw a dot at the last point (default true)

showMinMax.description: Sparkline: mark the min and max points

showValue.description: Sparkline: print the last value inline

colorByDirection.description: Slopegraph: accent rising lines and mute falling ones (default off)

intentId.description: Ghost intent id returned by canvas_intent signal. A vetoed or expired intent blocks this mutation.

nodeHeight.description: Alias for height — the frame-height name the graph and stream actions use

strictSize.description: Keep explicit width/height fixed and scroll overflowing content instead of browser auto-fitting

nodeId.description: Existing streaming node id to append to; omit to create a new streaming node

patches.description: SpecStream patches to apply this call: JSON-Patch objects ({op,path,value}) or raw JSONL patch lines

done.description: Set true on the final call to mark the stream complete

showLegend.description: Show chart legend when supported; pass false for compact node layouts

showLabels.description: Show direct labels when supported, such as pie slice labels (defaults to true)

heightPx.description: SDK alias for nodeHeight (node frame height)

tools.name: canvas_edge
tools.description: Add, update, or remove an edge (connection) between two nodes. Action "add" connects two nodes (type: flow=sequential, depends-on=dependency, relation=general, references=cross-reference; from/to take node ids, or fromSearch/toSearch resolve by title/content); "update" patches an existing edge in place (label, type, style, animated); "remove" deletes an edge by id.

intentId.description: Ghost intent id returned by canvas_intent signal. A vetoed or expired intent blocks this mutation.

fromSearch.description: Resolve the source node by exact or fuzzy title/content search

toSearch.description: Resolve the target node by exact or fuzzy title/content search

type.description: Edge type: flow, depends-on, relation, or references

style.description: Optional edge stroke style: solid, dashed, or dotted

edge_id.description: Alias for id (legacy HTTP body field)

tools.name: canvas_group
tools.description: Manage node groups. Action "create" makes a new group (optionally with initial child node ids); "add" moves nodes into an existing group; "ungroup" dissolves a group, releasing its children.

action.description: Operation to perform: create | add | ungroup.

intentId.description: Ghost intent id returned by canvas_intent signal. A vetoed or expired intent blocks this mutation.

childIds.description: Node IDs to include in the group. Group auto-sizes to fit them.

color.description: Group accent color (CSS color string, e.g. "#4a9eff")

x.description: X position (auto-computed from children if omitted)

y.description: Y position (auto-computed from children if omitted)

childLayout.description: Optional child auto-layout. Omit to preserve current child positions.

full.description: Return the full created group payload. Default false returns compact metadata.

tools.name: canvas_history
tools.description: Step through canvas mutation history. Action "undo" reverses the last mutation; "redo" reapplies it. History is session-scoped (in-memory, last 200 operations).

tools.name: canvas_view
tools.description: Canvas viewport and layout control. Action "arrange" auto-lays-out nodes (grid/columns/etc.); "focus" pans/zooms the viewport to a node; "fit" zooms to fit all nodes in view; "clear" removes every node and edge from the canvas; "remove-annotation" deletes a human-drawn annotation by id; "get-tour"/"set-tour" read or persist the presentation tour; "tour-go" presents a stop (stop index or step next/previous); "tour-exit" leaves presentation; "move" eases the camera to a nodeId, world rect or viewport over a duration. Camera actions never enter undo history.

action.description: Operation to perform: arrange | focus | fit | clear | remove-annotation | get-tour | set-tour | tour-go | tour-exit | move.

tour.description: Ordered camera stops, or null to derive from groups

stop.description: Zero-based stop index to go to

step.description: Step relative to the current stop (clamped at the ends)

present.description: Start presenting in viewers that are not presenting yet (default true; false only moves presenting viewers)

nodeId.description: Node or group id to frame

rect.description: World-space box { x, y, width, height } to frame

viewport.description: Exact screen-space camera { x, y, scale }

padding.description: Screen pixels around a node/rect target (default 40)

noPan.description: If true, raise/select the node without panning the viewport. Default false.

width.description: Viewport width used for fit math (default 1440)

height.description: Viewport height used for fit math (default 900)

nodeIds.description: Optional node IDs to fit instead of the whole canvas

tools.name: canvas_query
tools.description: Read the board cheapest-first. Action "context" returns a budgeted cross-board brief with a durable consumer cursor (budget is UTF-16 characters); "search" finds nodes by title/content keywords; "layout" returns the full layout; "validate" checks geometry and endpoints.

action.description: Operation to perform: context | search | layout | validate.

consumer.description: Stable consumer id used for the durable board-scoped cursor

since.description: Explicit content revision; bypasses the durable consumer cursor

budget.description: Maximum response size in UTF-16 code units

q.description: Search query — matches against node titles, content, and file paths

scope.description: Search the active board or the full board library

query.description: Search query — matches against node titles, content, and file paths

board.description: Board id to read without opening it.

includeBlobs.description: Include full blob payloads instead of blob summaries.

full.description: Return the full layout including node data. Default false keeps responses compact.

tools.name: canvas_app
tools.description: Open external / built-content apps on the canvas. Action "open-mcp-app" connects to an external MCP server that declares a ui:// app resource, calls a tool, and opens the result inside an mcp-app node (full transport call — pass transport + toolName); "diagram" draws a hand-drawn diagram via the hosted Excalidraw preset (pass elements); "build-artifact" bundles a single-file HTML web artifact from React/Tailwind source (title + appTsx) and optionally opens it on the canvas. build-artifact can be long-running (minutes) on cold workspaces — set a long client timeout.

action.description: Operation to perform: open-mcp-app | diagram | build-artifact.

toolName.description: Tool name on the external MCP server

serverName.description: Optional display name for the external MCP server

toolArguments.description: Arguments passed to the external tool call

nodeId.description: Existing mcp-app node ID to update in place instead of creating a new node.

timeoutMs.description: Optional MCP request timeout in milliseconds for cold external app servers

command.description: Executable used to start the external MCP server

transport.description: How PMX Canvas should connect to the external MCP server

anyOf.description: JSON array string of Excalidraw elements

elements.description: Excalidraw elements to render. See https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw-mcp for the element format.

files.description: Optional map of additional project-relative file paths to file contents

deps.description: Optional npm dependencies to install before bundling (e.g. ["recharts", "framer-motion@^11"]). Validated against npm-name format; flags and shell metacharacters are rejected.

projectPath.description: Optional workspace-relative reusable project path. Defaults to .pmx-canvas/artifacts/.web-artifacts/<slug>

outputPath.description: Optional workspace-relative HTML output path. Defaults to .pmx-canvas/artifacts/<slug>.html

openInCanvas.description: Open the generated artifact in canvas after build (default true)

includeLogs.description: Include raw build stdout/stderr in the response (default false)

initScriptPath.description: Optional script path override for tests/debugging. Must resolve inside the workspace.

bundleScriptPath.description: Optional script path override for tests/debugging. Must resolve inside the workspace.

tools.name: canvas_webview
tools.description: Drive the headless Bun.WebView automation session for the workbench. Action "status" reads automation status (supported, active, backend, viewport, url); "start" starts/replaces the session (backend chrome|webkit, width, height, chromePath, chromeArgv, dataStoreDir); "stop" stops the active session; "resize" sets the viewport (width, height required); "evaluate" runs JavaScript in the page (pass exactly one of expression or script; script is wrapped in an async IIFE). Capturing a screenshot is NOT folded here — use the standalone canvas_screenshot tool (it returns a binary image payload).

action.description: Operation to perform: status | start | stop | resize | evaluate.

backend.description: Automation backend. Default: webkit on macOS, chrome elsewhere.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page context

script.description: Multi-statement JavaScript body. The MCP server wraps it in an async IIFE and evaluates the resolved return value.

tools.name: canvas_ax_state
tools.description: Read or set host-agnostic PMX AX state. Action "get" reads the AX state + agent-ready context (pinned/focused context, focus field); "set-focus" places node IDs in the AX focus field (nodeIds); "set-policy" patches the tool/prompt policy (tools.allowed|excluded|approvalRequired, prompt.systemAppend|mode — merges with existing); "report-capability" records a host/session capability for diagnostics; "presence" reads agent presence (who is writing, phase, attached session); "set-presence" updates this caller's presence (phase idle|thinking|tooling|waiting-approval, detail, focusNodeId, cursor, attached — attached:true starts a session, false ends it; contextUsage {used,total} reports the agent's real token usage, which the board's context panel names). Adapters may pass a source label (e.g. codex).

action.description: Operation to perform: get | set-focus | set-policy | report-capability | presence | set-presence.

includeContext.description: Include serialized agent-ready AX context. Default true.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs to place in the AX focus field. Missing nodes are ignored.

source.description: Optional host/source label for adapter-originated focus. Defaults to mcp. Use codex from the Codex app adapter.

tools.description: Tool policy patch: allowed/excluded/approvalRequired arrays.

scope.description: Scope fence (human-owned, set from the workbench): { nodeIds, padding? } limits agent WRITES to those nodes plus padding px around them; null clears it. Agent calls that include it are refused (403) — read policy.scope instead.

agentScopes.description: Per-agent territories: writer key (agentId or source) → { nodeIds, padding? } | null. The orchestration surface — fence each worker to its lane; you cannot set your own key.

raw.description: Optional raw capability payload for diagnostics.

agentId.description: Stable identity for a genuinely separate agent, not a task name. Omit for the main agent when a host adapter already owns its session.

label.description: Display name for this writer; use detail for the current task

detail.description: Tool / step name shown beside the phase

focusNodeId.description: Node the agent is working on

attached.description: true attaches a session; false detaches it. Read presence first and reuse your host adapter session instead of attaching another. Only detach sessions you own.

contextUsage.description: The agent's real token usage as {used,total} — the board's context panel names how many tokens its whole context holds (null clears it)

tools.name: canvas_ax_work
tools.description: Manage canvas-bound AX work items and review annotations. Action "add" creates a work item (title, optional status todo|in-progress|blocked|done|cancelled, detail, nodeIds); "update" patches a work item by id (title/status/detail/nodeIds); "annotate" adds a review annotation (comment/finding) anchored to a node, file, or region (body, kind, severity, anchorType, nodeId/file/region). Work items and review annotations participate in snapshots and are exposed via canvas://ax-work.

action.description: Operation to perform: add | update | annotate.

title.description: Short title of the work item.

status.description: Work item status. Defaults to todo.

nodeIds.description: Optional node IDs this work item is tied to.

source.description: Optional host/source label. Defaults to mcp.

agentId.description: Optional per-agent identity within the host.

nodeId.description: Node ID when anchorType is node.

file.description: File path when anchorType is file.

region.description: Region descriptor when anchorType is region.

tools.name: canvas_ax_gate
tools.description: Drive the full lifecycle of a canvas-bound AX gate — request, resolve, or await — across all three gate kinds. kind: approval | elicitation | mode. action: request (open a pending gate), resolve (approval/mode take a decision approved|rejected; elicitation takes a response object), await (block until the gate leaves pending or timeoutMs elapses; 0 = immediate read). Gates are canvas-bound, snapshotted, and exposed via canvas://ax-work. NOTE: the approval machine-readable action identifier is passed as approvalAction (the action field is the lifecycle discriminator).

action.description: Operation to perform: request | resolve | await (× kind: approval | elicitation | mode).

title.description: Short title of what needs approval.

detail.description: Optional explanation of the action and its impact.

approvalAction.description: Optional machine-readable action identifier the approval gates.

nodeIds.description: Optional node IDs this approval relates to.

ttlMs.description: Unattended-approval TTL in ms; the gate auto-holds if unanswered (default 5 min, max 24 h).

source.description: Optional host/source label. Defaults to mcp.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to block (0 = immediate read; capped at 120000).

prompt.description: The question or instruction for the human.

fields.description: Optional field names to request (a simple structured form).

tools.name: canvas_ax_timeline
tools.description: Read or write the bounded PMX AX timeline. Action "read" returns recent agent-events, evidence, and steering messages plus counts (limit); "record-event" records a normalized agent-event (kind prompt|assistant-message|tool-start|tool-result|failure|approval|steering, summary, detail, data); "add-evidence" records an evidence item (kind logs|tool-result|screenshot|file|diff|test-output, title, body, ref); "send-steering" records a steering message (message); "reads" returns the context read log — which canvas context each agent read and which pinned nodes reached it — with a per-consumer summary (limit); "read-status" returns, per node on a board, when an agent last read its content, who, and the content revision it read (board). Timeline rows persist for diagnostics/continuity but are not restored by snapshots; exposed via canvas://ax-timeline.

action.description: Operation to perform: read | record-event | add-evidence | send-steering | reads | read-status.

limit.description: Max rows per timeline table (default 50, max 200).

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the event.

detail.description: Optional longer detail or payload text.

nodeIds.description: Optional node IDs this event relates to.

source.description: Optional host/source label. Defaults to mcp.

agentId.description: Optional per-agent identity within the host.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the evidence.

ref.description: Optional reference (path, URL, or external locator).

message.description: The steering instruction to deliver to the active agent session.

target.description: The agentId/consumer this steer is addressed to. Omit to broadcast to all consumers.

board.description: Board id; defaults to the open board.

tools.name: canvas_ax_delivery
tools.description: Adapterless PMX AX delivery. Action "claim" claims pending undelivered steering for a consumer (loop-safe — never returns steering the consumer originated) plus pendingActivity (open work items / approval gates / elicitations / mode requests awaiting the agent); "mark" marks a steering message delivered by id so it is not handed out again. Resolve pendingActivity via canvas_ax_gate / canvas_ax_work, not mark.

consumer.description: Consumer/source label to exclude from results (e.g. copilot, mcp).

order.description: Order of returned steering: "oldest" (FIFO, default) for ordered processing, or "newest" first to see the latest browser action when limited.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to block until steering arrives (0/omitted = immediate read).

id.description: The steering message id to mark delivered.

tools.name: canvas_intent
tools.description: Ghost Cursor of Intent — announce the spatial move you are ABOUT to make so the canvas paints a faint pre-commit placeholder (legibility: the human sees the next move forming, and can veto it). Action "signal" registers an intent (kind create|move|connect|remove|edit; pass position for move — omit it for create to ghost where the canvas will place the node, and the linked create lands there — nodeId for move/edit/remove, edge for connect; optional label, reason, confidence 0..1, seq, ttlMs, and a stable id); "update" patches a live intent by id; "clear" abandons/dissolves it. To make veto authoritative, pass the returned id as intentId on the real canvas_node/canvas_edge/canvas_group/canvas_render mutation: vetoed or expired intents are rejected, and a successful linked mutation settles the ghost automatically. Intents are ephemeral presence: never persisted, never snapshotted, auto-expire (~8s).

action.description: Operation to perform: signal | update | clear.

kind.description: create | move | connect | remove | edit — the move about to be made.

position.description: World coords: the destination of a move, or where a create forms. Omit it for a create to ghost where the canvas will place the node.

nodeId.description: The existing node a move/edit/remove targets.

edge.description: connect: the edge about to be drawn (from/to node ids + type).

nodeType.description: Node type the ghost renders (icon + type badge).

label.description: Short action label shown on the ghost chip ("Add evidence").

reason.description: Why — shown beneath the ghost. The legibility payoff.

seq.description: Ordering hint for staged-batch ghosts (numbered previsualization).

ttlMs.description: Auto-expire after this many ms (default 8000, max 60000).

id.description: Stable id to update/clear/veto later; auto-generated if omitted.

source.description: Optional source label of the signalling surface.

vetoed.description: Veto the intent: dissolves the ghost AND poisons the id so a later linked settle is rejected (same as clear { vetoed:true }).

settledNodeId.description: The real node this intent became — triggers the settle morph.

tools.name: canvas_ax_interaction
tools.description: Submit a node-originated AX interaction: a capability-gated, validated event from an eligible node that maps onto an AX operation (work item, evidence, approval, review, focus, steering, event). Returns { ok: false, code } if the node type/metadata does not allow the interaction type or the payload is invalid.

type.description: Interaction type, e.g. ax.work.create, ax.evidence.add, ax.focus.set.

source.description: Optional host/source label. Defaults to mcp.

tools.name: canvas_ingest_activity
tools.description: Ingest a normalized agent activity (a tool/session event your harness forwards) so the board reacts automatically — primitive A, makes AX bidirectional. Always records a timeline event; kind-driven default reactions (overridable per call via `reactions`): failure/error → work item (blocked) + review finding + evidence (logs); tool-result + outcome:"success" → evidence (tool-result); everything else (tool-start, session-*, command, note) → event only. Set any reaction to false to suppress it, or to an object to override its fields. Returns { event, workItem, evidence, review }.

ref.description: A file path, URL, or commit the activity refers to (used as the review file anchor for failures).

reactions.description: Override or suppress the kind-driven default reactions.

tools.name: canvas_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot from the active Bun.WebView automation session. Returns both an MCP image payload and JSON metadata. Requires an active automation session started via canvas_webview with action "start".

format.description: Screenshot format (default depends on Bun; png recommended)
